Privacy housekeeping

Privacy housekeeping

Review and remove unpublished contributions within 90 days. Review public contributions at least annually and honour withdrawal requests. Review newsletter registrations in Brevo and earlier Field Notes registrations below after 24 months or earlier withdrawal. Honour opt-outs in Brevo; do not re-import unsubscribed contacts. Retention is managed manually; there is no automatic deletion job. See the privacy notice.
